name.en: Fake job ad: “download our app to apply”

how.en: You answer a job ad or recruitment post on Facebook or another social network. The “recruiter” moves the chat to WhatsApp or Telegram, sends a link and asks you to install an app as part of the application. The app may be a fake Android job app that shows a fake Google Play update and asks for Accessibility access. Once installed, the phone may freeze or show a fake system update while scammers take passwords, banking details and money. Some people have had to replace their phones.

text.en: You respond to a job ad or recruitment post on social media.
The recruiter moves the chat to WhatsApp or Telegram.
They send a link and ask you to install an app to apply, then to allow Accessibility access.
The app gives scammers your passwords and bank access.
Thanks for applying! The next step is our onboarding app. Please install it from this link and allow the permissions so HR can verify you: [link]

en: Being asked to install an app before a proper conversation with an employer.
A link to an app outside the App Store or Google Play.
A request to allow Accessibility or install from unknown sources.
A quick move to WhatsApp or Telegram.
Only install apps from the Apple App Store or Google Play.
If you installed one, disconnect the phone, call your bank and get the phone checked or reset.
Check the employer independently before going further.
